newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 5.

text.p: CHINA TIMES - United States fires 17 more missiles into southern Iraq.
Government to crack down on businesses without operating licences.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Provincial Farmers Association says gangsters involved in tenders for imported garlic.
United States continues strike on Iraq.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Cabinet to give privileges to megamall projects with more than T$2 billion investment.
Communications ministry and Mainland Affairs Council to share responsibility in handling direct shipping links with China.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Germany-based ASI group and Taiwan's Teco Electric plan to invest jointly in China.
International oil prices and foreign exchange rates stabilise as Gulf tensions ease.
